title: The specified constant sheaf inclusion is an Artin-Schreier kernel
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and p a prime with p=0 in Γ(X,O_X). Let G be an abelian sheaf on its small etale site, with additive equivalences a_U:G(U)≃Γ(U,O_U) commuting with restrictions. Let wp:G→G and iota:constant ZMod p→G have zero composite. Suppose a_U(wp(x))=a_U(x)^p-a_U(x) and the image under iota of each constant-presheaf section c corresponds to the natural-number cast of c.val. Then iota is a categorical kernel of wp: the kernel fork with arrow iota is limiting. This asserts no epimorphy of wp.

proof.text: The natural equivalences identify the stalk of G with the filtered colimit of rings of functions over pointed etale neighbourhoods, the strict local ring. Characteristic p pulls back along the structural maps. The wp formula identifies the kernel equation on this colimit with r^p=r. The local-ring kernel theorem gives a unique c in ZMod p with r equal to its canonical image.

Use the constant-sheaf stalk isomorphism to identify the source stalk with ULift ZMod p; the iota formula computes its map as the prime-field inclusion. Stalk functors preserve finite limits, so this is a bijection to the stalk of the categorical kernel. Thus the map from the constant sheaf to kernel wp is invertible at each geometric point.

Conservativity of the universe-lifted geometric points gives an isomorphism from the constant sheaf to kernel wp. Transporting the canonical limiting kernel fork by this isomorphism proves that the specified fork is limiting. The empty scheme is included: its family of geometric points is empty but still conservative.

theorem artinSchreier_section_data_isKernel (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hp : (p : Γ(X, ⊤)) = 0)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (a : ∀ U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ, G.obj.obj U ≃+ Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
    (wp : G ⟶ G) (iota : X.constantZMod p ⟶ G) (hzero : iota ≫ wp = 0)
    (hrestr : ∀ (U V : X.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V) (x : G.obj.obj U),
      a V (G.obj.map g x) = g.unop.left.appTop (a U x))
    (hwp : ∀ (U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G.obj.obj U),
      a U (wp.hom.app U x) = (a U x) ^ p - a U x)
    (hiota : ∀ (U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ) (c : ZMod p),
      a U (iota.hom.app U
        ((toSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology
          ((Functor.const X.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod p))))).app U (ULift.up c))) =
        (c.val : Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))) :
    Nonempty (Limits.IsLimit (Limits.KernelFork.ofι iota hzero))
